```lean
import CategoryTheory.Limits
import CategoryTheory.Preadditive
import CategoryTheory.Yoneda

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] (X : C) : 
  CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimits (CategoryTheory.preadditiveYoneda.obj X) := by
  haveI : CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimitsOfSize (CategoryTheory.yoneda.obj X) :=
    CategoryTheory.yoneda_preservesLimits X
  exact CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimitsOfSize.toPreservesLimits this
```
